metadata.title: Why a Particle in a Box Cannot Sit Still
metadata.thing: a half-wave pinned between two walls, never able to flatten
metadata.color_notes: Wavefunction arch = accent Warm Slate #5A5653. The forbidden flat/still attempt = red #C0392B. Walls, floor, labels = ink #1a1a1a.

beats.narration_text: Drop a marble into a box and it settles on the floor, perfectly still.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Drop a marble into a box and it settles on the floor, perfectly still.
beats.new_visual_element: a person dropping a marble into a box; it rests on the floor

beats.end_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = the person looking into the box, a marble resting still on the floor of the box]

beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: Try the same with a quantum particle, and it refuses to ever hold still.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Try the same with a quantum particle, and it refuses to ever hold still.
beats.new_visual_element: the person puzzled as the quantum particle keeps jittering in the box
beats.start_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = a person looking into a box at a tiny jittering particle]
beats.end_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = the person puzzled, the tiny particle blurred with motion lines inside the box]
beats.video_animation_prompt: the person and box draw in, a tiny particle jitters with motion lines and never settles, the person looks puzzled; no hand visible, white background, napkin art doodle style
beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: Trap the particle between two hard walls; its wave must fall to zero at each.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Trap the particle between two hard walls; its wave must fall to zero at each.
beats.new_visual_element: two vertical walls with a floor; markers showing the wave must be zero at both walls
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw two vertical walls and a floor line; mark dots at the base of each wall showing the wave is pinned to zero there

beats.narration_text: A perfectly flat, still wave would have to be zero everywhere — so nothing is there.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A perfectly flat, still wave would have to be zero everywhere — so nothing is there.
beats.new_visual_element: a flat red line on the floor that fades to nothing (the still attempt fails)
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw a flat red line along the floor between the walls, then fade it to nothing — a still wave is just zero, no particle; red #C0392B

beats.narration_text: The smallest wave that fits is one gentle arch, peaking in the middle, zero at the walls.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The smallest wave that fits is one gentle arch, peaking in the middle, zero at the walls.
beats.new_visual_element: a half-sine arch in accent, touching zero at both walls, peaking at centre
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw a smooth half-sine arch in Warm Slate from the base of the left wall, peaking at centre, back to the base of the right wall

beats.narration_text: That arch is curved, and a quantum wave's curvature is exactly its kinetic energy.
beats.tts_normalized_text: That arch is curved, and a quantum wave's curvature is exactly its kinetic energy.
beats.new_visual_element: the arch's curvature highlighted, linked to an energy mark
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: highlight the bending of the arch (a curvature glyph at the peak) and draw a small 'energy' bar/label tying curvature to kinetic energy

beats.narration_text: A flatter wave would carry less energy, but the walls forbid going completely flat.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A flatter wave would carry less energy, but the walls forbid going completely flat.
beats.new_visual_element: the arch tries to flatten toward the floor and snaps back (can't reach zero)
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: animate the arch lowering toward the floor then springing back to its half-sine shape — it cannot flatten without vanishing

beats.narration_text: So the lowest allowed state still bulges and curves — it still carries motion.
beats.tts_normalized_text: So the lowest allowed state still bulges and curves — it still carries motion.
beats.new_visual_element: an energy-level line above the floor (E1 > 0) beside the arch
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw a horizontal energy level above the floor labelled with a small upward gap from zero, marking the ground state sits above zero energy

beats.narration_text: Squeeze the box narrower and the arch sharpens, forcing the energy even higher.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Squeeze the box narrower and the arch sharpens, forcing the energy even higher.
beats.new_visual_element: the walls move inward, the arch steepens, the energy level rises
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: redraw walls + arch; animate the walls moving inward so the arch becomes narrower and taller-curvature, and an energy level marker rising

beats.narration_text: It can never sit still; confinement itself guarantees a restless lowest state.
beats.tts_normalized_text: It can never sit still; confinement itself guarantees a restless lowest state.
beats.new_visual_element: the arch with an 'E-one, ground state' label sitting above the floor, never zero
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: settle on the arch with a handwritten 'E1 ground state' label on the energy level above the floor; clean close emphasising it never reaches zero
